title: Armless Quarter-Corner Sofa Module
description: One original complete armless quarter-corner sofa module. A full quarter-disc foundation and softly stepped sector cushion sit above a recessed quarter plinth; one continuous padded annular back curves through ninety degrees around the outer seat boundary. Its two radial open sides define only this standalone geometric family, not a snap or dimensional compatibility claim with older sofas. Newly authored curved corner geometry, not an extracted or resized straight two-seat sofa, nor a shortened concave L dining banquette. Static furniture appearance only: no comfort, load, stability, upholstery simulation, fastening or installation guarantee.
